name: animica
description: Animica AI: ask the ENA open-AI network, generate and verify quantum-random draws, verify qDNA training provenance, estimate serverless compute, and read Animica chain/pool stats. READ + COMPUTE only — no signing, spending, or wallet access.
notes: Start the server with `animica mcp serve --transport http --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8765` and place TLS / a tunnel in front so the /mcp endpoint is reachable over HTTPS. The same server (stdio) also powers the Claude Code plugin.
